questions.question: Work out 3/4 plus 3/4 and write the answer as a mixed number.
questions.expected_answer: Add the tops and keep the bottom: 6/4. Four quarters make 1 whole, with 2 quarters left over, so 6/4 is 1 and 2/4.

questions.question: A pizza has 12 slices and 5/12 of it is eaten. What fraction is left? Explain.
questions.expected_answer: The whole pizza is 12/12. 12/12 minus 5/12 is 7/12, so 7/12 of the pizza is left. Check: 7/12 plus 5/12 is 12/12.

questions.question: Work out 3 and 1/4 minus 1 and 3/4.
questions.expected_answer: 1/4 is less than 3/4, so break one whole into 4 quarters: 3 and 1/4 becomes 2 and 5/4. Then 2 minus 1 is 1 and 5/4 minus 3/4 is 2/4, so the answer is 1 and 2/4.
